text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.0685 for the Senior C++ Engineer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications is that they "Built REST APIs" and have experience with "Machine Learning". Key gaps include a lack of required experience in C++, Boost, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and various database technologies, as well as insufficient total years of experience. This application was escalated for manual review despite the low fit, missing must-have requirements, and a location mismatch.
